# StreamExtended

.NET library for peeking TLS ClientHello / ServerHello (SNI, ALPN, and other extensions) before `SslStream` authentication.

## API

Browse the [API documentation](api/StreamExtended.html).

## Install

```bash
dotnet add package StreamExtended
```
